subject: math
topicName: Geometry - Lesson 3: General Form of a Circle
description: Identify circle equations written in expanded form by recognizing squared x- and y-terms, matching coefficients, and interpreting constants.
learningObjectives: Recognize the general form of a circle equation
Distinguish circle equations from non-circle equations using coefficients
Identify the x-coefficient, y-coefficient, and constant term in expanded form
Connect expanded form to center-radius form
Explain why an equation does or does not represent a circle
prerequisites: Basic equation vocabulary: coefficient, constant, and term
